source.note: GGM Gastro became an Official Partner of Everton Women in their first season at Goodison Park, with the brand mark on the back of the shorts worn by Everton Women; article body read via the club's news CMS (article bf9b9b90-a5c2-11f0-a06d-1b26a8313bb6).

summary: German catering-equipment supplier GGM Gastro pays for the back of the Everton Women shorts.
